capabilities: customize timer modes, sequence, and durations
display timer as status bar or panel widget
start timer from the Command Palette
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README lists unimplemented future features (per-mode sounds, tasks view, logging, custom shapes).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in timer, so users who work in Pomodoro sessions must leave the app or use generic timers.
summary: Pomodoro timer with customizable modes, durations, notification sounds, and colors, usable as a status bar or panel widget.
